# Terraform reference

Every input and output of the module in `terraform/`. An input with no default is required.

## Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `box_id` | `string` | `"main"` | no | Box id, used in names, SSM paths and tags. |
| `name_prefix` | `string` | `"dozebox"` | no | Prefix of every resource name, SSM path and tag key. |
| `instance` | `object (see below)` | n/a | yes | Instance types (first is preferred), CPU architecture, machine mode, AMI parameter (default: Canonical Ubuntu 24.04 for the arch) and root disk size. |
| `network` | `object (see below)` | `{}` | no | Create a VPC (default) or use an existing one. No inbound rule unless ssh_cidrs is set. |
| `data_volume` | `object (see below)` | n/a | yes | The encrypted gp3 data volume that holds all payload state. |
| `snapshots` | `object (see below)` | `{}` | no | DLM snapshot interval and retention, Recycle Bin days, and how long a retired volume is kept. |
| `idle_minutes` | `number` | `30` | no | Minutes without activity or presence before the box parks itself. |
| `no_progress_park_minutes` | `number` | `150` | no | Minutes without payload progress before the box parks even when a hold is open. |
| `caps` | `object (see below)` | n/a | yes | Hard limits on awake time, On-Demand time and monthly spend. |
| `fallback` | `object (see below)` | `{}` | no | The On-Demand fallback group. unattended = true lets scheduled and event wakes use On-Demand. |
| `alerts` | `object (see below)` | `{}` | no | Where alerts go. Secret fields are names under /&lt;prefix&gt;/shared/, never values. |
| `front_door_enabled` | `bool` | `true` | no | CloudFront with OAC and WAF in front of the control Function URL. |
| `waf_rate_limit_per_5min` | `number` | `300` | no | Requests per 5 minutes per client address before the WAF rate rule blocks. |
| `wake_sources` | `object (see below)` | `{}` | no | Outside wake sources. Secrets are names under /&lt;prefix&gt;/shared/, never values. |
| `wake_budget` | `object (see below)` | `{}` | no | Most outside-event wakes per hour and per day. |
| `payloads` | `any` | n/a | yes | Payload definitions by name (part 5 §5.5). The agent validates each at boot. |
| `agent` | `object (see below)` | n/a | yes | Agent release. version = "none" renders user data that only logs and powers off (test stacks). |
| `jail` | `object (see below)` | `{}` | no | Jail for agents the payload launches, and its egress mode. |
| `tripwire_enabled` | `bool` | `true` | no | Decoy key and CloudTrail data path. |
| `restore_test` | `object (see below)` | `{}` | no | Weekly restore test of the latest snapshot on a throwaway instance. |
| `fis_enabled` | `bool` | `false` | no | FIS templates for drills, with a stop condition on the cap alarm. |
| `log_retention_days` | `number` | `30` | no | Retention of every log group the module creates. |
| `enable_ssm_session` | `bool` | `false` | no | Adds the scoped Session Manager policy to the instance role. |
| `tags` | `map(string)` | `{}` | no | Added to every resource. The module adds &lt;prefix&gt;:box = &lt;box_id&gt;. |
| `drill_mode` | `bool` | `false` | no | Test stacks only. Uses a data volume without prevent_destroy so a drill can tear the stack down. |
| `control_bundle_path` | `string` | `null` | no | Zip of the control function (control.mjs exporting handler). Null deploys a placeholder that answers 503 not_deployed. |
| `iam_permissions_boundary` | `string` | `null` | no | ARN of a managed policy set as the permissions boundary of every IAM role the module creates; null for none. For accounts whose deploy principal may only create bounded roles. |
| `ssm_prefix` | `string` | `null` | no | SSM path prefix override, such as /legacy/main/. Null: /&lt;name_prefix&gt;/&lt;box_id&gt;/. |
| `tag_prefix` | `string` | `null` | no | Tag key prefix override for the &lt;prefix&gt;:box, :role and :active tags. Null: name_prefix. |

## Object inputs

### instance

```hcl
object({
  types             = list(string)
  arch              = optional(string, "arm64")
  machine_mode      = optional(string, "persistent")
  ami_ssm_parameter = optional(string)
  root_volume_gb    = optional(number, 30)
})
```

### network

```hcl
object({
  create     = optional(bool, true)
  vpc_id     = optional(string)
  subnet_ids = optional(list(string), [])
  ssh_cidrs  = optional(list(string), [])
})
```

### data_volume

```hcl
object({
  size_gb     = number
  iops        = optional(number, 3000)
  throughput  = optional(number, 125)
  kms_key_arn = optional(string)
})
```

### snapshots

```hcl
object({
  every_hours         = optional(number, 24)
  keep                = optional(number, 7)
  recycle_bin_days    = optional(number, 7)
  retired_volume_days = optional(number, 14)
})
```

### caps

```hcl
object({
  awake_hours_per_day     = optional(number)
  on_demand_hours_per_day = optional(number, 3)
  monthly_budget_usd      = number
  max_spot_price_per_hour = optional(number)
  freeze_on_budget        = optional(bool, true)
})
```

### fallback

```hcl
object({
  enabled    = optional(bool, true)
  unattended = optional(bool, false)
  types      = optional(list(string))
})
```

### alerts

```hcl
object({
  email               = optional(string)
  ntfy_secret         = optional(string)
  web_push            = optional(bool, true)
  webhook_secret      = optional(string)
  healthchecks_secret = optional(string)
})
```

### wake_sources

```hcl
object({
  github  = optional(object({ enabled = bool, secret = string }))
  generic = optional(object({ enabled = bool, secret = string }))
})
```

### wake_budget

```hcl
object({
  per_hour = optional(number, 6)
  per_day  = optional(number, 24)
})
```

### agent

```hcl
object({
  version           = string
  artifact_base_url = optional(string)
  sha256            = optional(map(string))
})
```

### jail

```hcl
object({
  enabled     = optional(bool, true)
  egress      = optional(string, "imds-only")
  allow_hosts = optional(list(string), [])
})
```

### restore_test

```hcl
object({
  enabled           = optional(bool, true)
  schedule          = optional(string, "cron(0 4 ? * SUN *)")
  close_after_hours = optional(number, 2)
})
```

## Input rules

Terraform rejects a value that breaks one of these at plan time.

- `box_id`: box_id must match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,19}$.
- `name_prefix`: name_prefix must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,15}$.
- `instance`: instance.types must list 1 to 10 instance types.
- `instance`: instance.types entries must look like an instance type, such as t4g.small.
- `instance`: instance.arch must be arm64 or x86_64.
- `instance`: instance.machine_mode must be persistent or group.
- `instance`: instance.root_volume_gb must be between 8 and 1024.
- `network`: network.vpc_id and network.subnet_ids are required when network.create is false.
- `network`: network.ssh_cidrs entries must be CIDR blocks.
- `data_volume`: data_volume.size_gb must be between 20 and 4096.
- `data_volume`: data_volume.iops must be between 3000 and 80000 (gp3).
- `data_volume`: data_volume.throughput must be between 125 and 2000 MiB/s (gp3).
- `data_volume`: data_volume.kms_key_arn must be a KMS key ARN.
- `snapshots`: snapshots.every_hours must be one of 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 24 (DLM intervals).
- `snapshots`: snapshots.keep must be between 1 and 1000.
- `snapshots`: snapshots.recycle_bin_days must be between 1 and 365.
- `snapshots`: snapshots.retired_volume_days must be between 1 and 365.
- `idle_minutes`: idle_minutes must be between 5 and 720.
- `no_progress_park_minutes`: no_progress_park_minutes must be between 30 and 1440.
- `caps`: caps.monthly_budget_usd must be greater than 0.
- `caps`: caps.awake_hours_per_day must be greater than 0 and at most 24.
- `caps`: caps.on_demand_hours_per_day must be between 0 and 24.
- `caps`: caps.max_spot_price_per_hour must be greater than 0 when set.
- `fallback`: fallback.types must not be empty when set (leave it unset to use instance.types).
- `fallback`: fallback.types must be a subset of instance.types.
- `alerts`: alerts.email must be an email address.
- `alerts`: alerts secret names must match ^[a-z0-9-]{1,40}$ (names under /&lt;prefix&gt;/shared/, not values).
- `waf_rate_limit_per_5min`: waf_rate_limit_per_5min must be a whole number of at least 10.
- `wake_sources`: wake_sources secret names must match ^[a-z0-9-]{1,40}$ (names under /&lt;prefix&gt;/shared/, not values).
- `wake_budget`: wake_budget.per_hour must be at least 1 and wake_budget.per_day at least per_hour.
- `payloads`: payloads must be a map of 1 to 4 payload definitions.
- `payloads`: payload names must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,30}$.
- `agent`: agent.version must be a semantic version such as 1.0.0, or none.
- `agent`: agent.artifact_base_url must be an https URL.
- `agent`: agent.sha256 maps arm64 or x86_64 to a 64-character lowercase hex SHA-256.
- `jail`: jail.egress must be imds-only or allowlist.
- `jail`: jail.allow_hosts must list at most 64 host names.
- `restore_test`: restore_test.schedule must be a cron(...) or rate(...) expression.
- `restore_test`: restore_test.close_after_hours must be between 1 and 24.
- `log_retention_days`: log_retention_days must be a CloudWatch Logs retention value (1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, ...).
- `tags`: tags keys must not start with aws: (reserved by AWS).
- `tags`: tags must not set &lt;prefix&gt;:box; the module sets it from box_id.
- `control_bundle_path`: control_bundle_path must name a .zip file.
- `iam_permissions_boundary`: iam_permissions_boundary must be a managed policy ARN (arn:&lt;partition&gt;:iam::&lt;account&gt;:policy/&lt;name&gt;) or null.
- `ssm_prefix`: ssm_prefix must start and end with / and use only letters, digits, _, . and -.
- `tag_prefix`: tag_prefix must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,15}$.

## Outputs

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `box_id` | The box id. |
| `region` | The region the stack is in. |
| `control_url` | Base URL of the control API: the Function URL (AWS_IAM with front_door_enabled, else public). CloudFront is not built yet. |
| `control_function_name` | For aws lambda invoke admin calls. |
| `ssm_prefix` | /&lt;prefix&gt;/&lt;box_id&gt;/. |
| `wake_token_parameter` | Name of the SecureString holding the wake token (not the value). |
| `alert_topic_arn` | SNS topic. |
| `instance_role_arn` | Role of the box. |
| `state_table_name` | DynamoDB table (lease, outbox, ledgers). |
| `dashboard_url` | CloudWatch dashboard. |
| `data_volume_id` | The volume tagged active at apply time. |
| `persistent_instance_id` | The persistent Spot instance (machine_mode persistent), else null. |
| `iam_policy_sizes` | Characters of every managed policy as AWS counts them (limit 6,144; the module's budget 5,500). |
| `front_door_domain_name` | CloudFront domain of the front door, or null when it is off (or not built yet). |
| `front_door_distribution_id` | CloudFront distribution id, or null when the front door is off (or not built yet). |
| `waf_web_acl_arn` | WAF web ACL in front of the control API, or null when the front door is off (or not built yet). |
| `tag_prefix` | The tag key prefix in use. |
